title: 无菌操作与平板划线
source_doc: course/General Lab Safety Practices/01_Aseptic Technique & Streak Plate.md
author_source: project/General Lab Safety Practices/01_Aseptic Technique & Streak Plate/src.py

points.K9: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落
points.K23: 肉汤培养物：摇匀与标记

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验台旁，台上有本生灯、培养皿和接种环
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with an unlit Bunsen burner, a stack of empty petri dishes and a wire inoculating loop, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲无菌操作和平板划线。

shots.scene: 无菌操作、平板划线、安全收尾三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a shield over a lab bench, a petri dish with streak lines, and a hand under a running tap. No people.
shots.narration: 从准备、划线，到培养和收尾。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着一块长满各色斑点的平板发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns while holding up a petri dish covered with many spots of different colors and sizes.
shots.narration: 阿杰的平板长满了杂菌。

shots.scene: 一块平板上菌苔连成一片、看不出单个菌落
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a petri dish with one thick continuous smear of growth and no separate dots. No people.
shots.narration: 也找不到一个单独的菌落。

shots.scene: 阿杰在凌乱的台面上操作、皿盖敞着的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A floating icon of a messy bench with an open petri dish lid lying aside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他台面没消毒，皿盖还一直敞着。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指着本生灯和接种环
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points to a Bunsen burner and a wire inoculating loop on a clean bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：无菌和划线，每步都有讲究。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 我们跟着小研，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块干净透明的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a clean, clear petri dish with smooth pale agar inside.
shots.narration: 无菌操作，就是营造并保持无菌环境。

shots.scene: 空气中漂浮的小点被一个盾牌挡在平板外
shots.prompt_en: Tiny floating dots in the air are blocked by a shield icon above an open petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 防止空气、台面和手上的杂菌混进来。

shots.scene: 平板上只有一种整齐的菌落，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with neat round colonies all of the same color, next to a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确保转接过去的，只有目标菌。

shots.scene: 小研拿起空白标签的喷壶，向台面喷洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a spray bottle with a blank label and sprays the bench surface.
shots.narration: 动手前，先给台面喷消毒剂。

shots.scene: 台面上的灰尘和小点被喷雾覆盖后消失
shots.prompt_en: Dust and tiny dots on a bench surface fade away under a fine mist of spray. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒剂能去除灰尘和台面上的杂菌。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾把台面擦干，丢进垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench dry with a paper towel and drops it into an ordinary trash can.
shots.narration: 用纸巾擦干，丢进垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 本生灯火焰上方有一圈淡淡的保护区
shots.prompt_en: A Bunsen burner flame with a faint glowing dome around the air above it. No people.
shots.narration: 本生灯是营造无菌区的关键。

shots.scene: 空气中的小点在火焰上方被热气流推开
shots.prompt_en: Small floating dots drift away from the area above the flame, carried off by rising warm air arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰让周围空气形成一片无菌区。

shots.scene: 小研擦完台面后走向本生灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts away the paper towel and reaches toward the Bunsen burner.
shots.narration: 台面擦好后，尽快点燃本生灯。

shots.scene: 小研划着一根火柴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student strikes a match beside an unlit Bunsen burner.
shots.narration: 先划着火柴。

shots.scene: 本生灯进气孔转到关闭位置的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the air hole collar on a Bunsen burner being turned to the closed position. No people.
shots.narration: 确认灯管的进气孔是关着的。

shots.scene: 小研打开燃气阀，火柴靠近灯口点燃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns on the gas tap and brings the lit match to the top of the burner; a tall yellow flame appears.
shots.narration: 再开燃气阀，听到出气声就点火。

shots.scene: 用过的火柴丢进装废移液管的桶
shots.prompt_en: A used match is dropped into a tall bench bin holding used plastic pipettes. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的火柴，丢进移液管废弃桶。

shots.scene: 高大的橙黄色火焰在灯口晃动
shots.prompt_en: A tall, wavy orange-yellow flame on a Bunsen burner. No people.
shots.narration: 暂时不用火，就调成黄色火焰。

shots.scene: 近乎透明的蓝色火焰与醒目的黄色火焰对比
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: a nearly invisible pale blue flame with a question mark and a bright yellow flame with an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色火焰看得清，不容易忘记它。

shots.scene: 手臂穿过火焰的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm reaching across a flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得手或手臂无意中穿过火焰。

shots.scene: 小研指着两块空白标签的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at two petri dishes with pale agar, one with colonies and one empty.
shots.narration: 平板划线法，用来转接和分离菌。

shots.scene: 固体平板和肉汤瓶都用箭头指向一块新平板
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with colonies and a small screw-cap bottle of cloudy broth, both with arrows pointing to a fresh petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 从固体或肉汤，转到新的固体培养基上。

shots.scene: 空白标签的营养琼脂平板和杆状菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A fresh petri dish of pale agar next to a simple rod-shaped bacterium icon. No people.
shots.narration: 本例：营养琼脂平板，大肠杆菌。

shots.scene: 小研拿起记号笔和倒扣的平板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a marker pen and a petri dish turned upside down.
shots.narration: 划线前，先给平板做标记。

shots.scene: 平板边缘依次亮起四段空白标记
shots.prompt_en: An upside-down petri dish with four short blank marks lighting up one after another around its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 写培养基缩写和本人姓名缩写。

shots.scene: 平板边缘后两段标记亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last two blank marks around the edge of the dish light up. No people.
shots.narration: 再写菌名或练习编号，还有日期。

shots.scene: 皿盖被拿走、只剩皿底上的标记依然清楚
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish lid floats away while the marks on the base stay in place, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 标记写在皿底，皿盖丢了也认得出。

shots.scene: 标记写在平板正中的图标被打叉，沿边环写的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: marks written across the middle of a dish crossed out with a red X, and marks written around the rim with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 沿边缘环写，不挡住长出的菌落。

shots.section_title: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落
shots.scene: 空白示意图上圆内分四个区
shots.prompt_en: A blank sheet with a large circle divided into four streaking zones with arrows, numbered by small dots. No people.
shots.narration: 划线要分四个区，一区接一区。
overlay: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落

shots.section_title: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落
shots.scene: 四个区里的小点从密到稀
shots.prompt_en: Inside the circle, dots are dense in the first zone and get sparser zone by zone. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是一路稀释，越划越少。

shots.section_title: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落
shots.scene: 单个点长大成一个圆形菌落
shots.prompt_en: A single dot grows into one round colony. No people.
shots.narration: 一个活细胞，通常长成一个菌落。

shots.section_title: 划线的目的：稀释出单菌落
shots.scene: 第四区出现分散的单个菌落
shots.prompt_en: The fourth zone shows separate round colonies spaced apart. No people.
shots.narration: 到第四区，就能得到单个菌落。

shots.scene: 第四区画成不与第三区相交的平行线
shots.prompt_en: In the circle diagram, the fourth zone is drawn as parallel lines that do not touch the third zone. No people.
shots.narration: 第四区可划平行线，不碰第三区。

shots.scene: 第四区画成一条竖线加向中心的蛇形线
shots.prompt_en: In the circle diagram, the fourth zone is drawn as one straight line followed by a zigzag into the center. No people.
shots.narration: 也可划一条竖线，再蛇形划向中央。

shots.scene: 两种画法都打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Both diagram versions shown side by side, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这两种方法都可以。

shots.scene: 本生灯火焰从黄色变成蓝色，内焰顶点清楚
shots.prompt_en: A Bunsen burner flame turns from yellow to blue, with the tip of the inner cone clearly visible. No people.
shots.narration: 转接前，把火焰调成蓝色。

shots.scene: 接种环示意：一根金属丝，末端一个小圈
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of an inoculating loop: a handle, a long metal wire and a small ring at the tip. No people.
shots.narration: 接种环是末端带小圈的金属丝。

shots.scene: 小研把接种环放进蓝色火焰，金属丝发红
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the wire loop in the blue flame and the wire glows red-orange.
shots.narration: 放进蓝色火焰，烧到发红。

shots.scene: 金属丝从环到杆整根发红
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the whole wire, from the ring to the shaft, glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 环和环杆整根都要烧到。

shots.scene: 小研把接种环停在火焰旁边几秒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the loop still just beside the flame, not in it.
shots.narration: 烧完在火焰旁停几秒，让它冷却。

shots.scene: 环轻触琼脂表面空白处
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the loop tip gently touching a clear spot on the agar surface. No people.
shots.narration: 把环轻触琼脂表面检验一下。

shots.scene: 热环碰到琼脂冒烟发出声响的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot glowing loop touching agar with steam puffs, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有嗞嗞声，说明已经凉了。

shots.scene: 细菌图标碰到发红的环后消失
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium icon touches a red-hot ring and fades away. No people.
shots.narration: 环太热，会把要转接的菌烫死。

shots.scene: 小研打开源平板一侧皿盖，用环挑起一个菌落
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the lid of a source petri dish slightly and picks up one round colony with the loop.
shots.narration: 从原平板上挑取一个单菌落。

shots.scene: 倒扣的新平板翻成正面朝上
shots.prompt_en: A labeled petri dish lying upside down is turned right side up. No people.
shots.narration: 标记时平板倒扣，划线前要翻正。

shots.scene: 皿底用笔轻画四区示意线
shots.prompt_en: Faint guide lines in four zones drawn on the underside of a petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 不熟练时，可在皿底先画好划线位置。

shots.scene: 小研一手斜举皿盖，一手在琼脂边缘来回划
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the dish lid tilted above the dish with one hand and moves the loop back and forth near the edge of the agar.
shots.narration: 第一区：带菌的环在琼脂上来回划。

shots.scene: 琼脂像果冻一样，一道裂口的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of agar like soft jelly with a torn gash in it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 动作要轻，琼脂像果冻，容易划破。

shots.scene: 小研盖好皿盖，把环再放进火焰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the lid and puts the loop back into the flame until it glows.
shots.narration: 划完一区，重新灼烧接种环。

shots.scene: 环上的小点被火焰清空
shots.prompt_en: Many tiny dots on a loop disappear in a flame, leaving a clean ring. No people.
shots.narration: 烧掉环上多余的菌，这就是稀释。

shots.scene: 手把平板转动一个角度
shots.prompt_en: A hand rotates a closed petri dish on the bench by a quarter turn, shown with a curved arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 转动平板，准备划第二区。

shots.scene: 第二区的线条穿过第一区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: new lines of the second zone start inside the first zone and cross out of it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二区要和第一区相交。

shots.scene: 环划一道、抬起、再划一道
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the loop drawing one line on the agar, lifting off, and drawing the next line. No people.
shots.narration: 每划一道就抬起，再划下一道。

shots.scene: 皿盖迅速盖回平板
shots.prompt_en: A hand quickly lowers the lid back onto the petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 每区划完，马上盖回皿盖。

shots.scene: 敞开的平板上方落下小点、旁边计时钟的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open petri dish with dots falling in and a clock ticking beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 平板敞着越久，越容易落进杂菌。

shots.scene: 小研让环冷却后轻触琼脂检验
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lets the loop cool and touches it lightly to a clear spot on the agar.
shots.narration: 环冷却后，先触琼脂检验。

shots.scene: 第三区线条穿过第二区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lines of the third zone cross the second zone after the dish is turned. No people.
shots.narration: 转动平板，与第二区相交划第三区。

shots.scene: 盖盖、灼烧、转盘的三个小图标循环
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons in a loop with arrows: closing a lid, a loop in a flame, and a rotating dish. No people.
shots.narration: 盖盖、灼烧、冷却，再转动平板。

shots.scene: 第四区线条穿过第三区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lines of the fourth zone cross the third zone. No people.
shots.narration: 与第三区相交，划出第四区。

shots.scene: 接种环翻转过来
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning the loop over so the other side of the ring faces down. No people.
shots.narration: 第四区划完，把环翻过来。

shots.scene: 一条竖线穿过线条，再蛇形划向平板中央
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one straight line through the earlier lines, then a zigzag running toward the center of the dish. No people.
shots.narration: 划一条竖线，再蛇形划向中央。

shots.scene: 中央出现分散的单个菌落
shots.prompt_en: The center of the dish shows separate round colonies spaced apart. No people.
shots.narration: 这样能得到分得很开的单菌落。

shots.scene: 小研最后一次灼烧接种环
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the loop in the blue flame one more time until it glows.
shots.narration: 操作结束，再把接种环烧一遍。

shots.scene: 接种环靠在本生灯底座旁冷却
shots.prompt_en: The loop rests safely at the base of the Bunsen burner, pointing away from the edge of the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 放在本生灯底座处冷却。

shots.scene: 小研把平板举到灯光前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the finished petri dish up against a light, looking at it closely.
shots.narration: 对着光，能看到划线的痕迹。

shots.scene: 平板上浅浅的划痕组成四区图案
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of faint streak marks on the agar forming a four-zone pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 看到划痕，说明环碰到了琼脂表面。

shots.scene: 小研把平板倒扣过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the finished petri dish upside down on the bench.
shots.narration: 培养时，平板要倒过来放。

shots.scene: 正放平板皿盖上的水珠滴到琼脂上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an upright dish with water droplets forming on the lid and dripping onto the agar, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得皿盖上的冷凝水滴下来污染。

shots.scene: 霉菌图标旁一个问号和一本空白课本
shots.prompt_en: A fuzzy mould icon next to a question mark and a blank course manual. No people.
shots.narration: 某些真菌可以不倒置，以课堂要求为准。

shots.section_title: 肉汤培养物：摇匀与标记
shots.scene: 小研轻轻旋摇装浑浊肉汤的螺口瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently swirls a small screw-cap glass bottle of cloudy broth.
shots.narration: 接下来从肉汤取菌，先轻轻摇匀。
overlay: 肉汤培养物：摇匀与标记

shots.section_title: 肉汤培养物：摇匀与标记
shots.scene: 瓶中的小点从沉在底部变成均匀分布
shots.prompt_en: Inside a bottle, dots settled at the bottom spread evenly through the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 让菌体均匀悬浮在肉汤里。

shots.section_title: 肉汤培养物：摇匀与标记
shots.scene: 新的倒扣平板边缘写标记
shots.prompt_en: A new petri dish lying upside down gets blank marks around its rim. No people.
shots.narration: 新平板同样标记，再翻正。

shots.scene: 环杆大部分伸进瓶中的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a loop reaching deep into a bottle, with most of its shaft inside. No people.
shots.narration: 取肉汤时，环杆大半要伸进瓶里。

shots.scene: 小研从环杆到环整根灼烧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student passes the whole wire, from shaft to ring, through the flame until it glows.
shots.narration: 所以环杆也必须烧到。

shots.scene: 小研用小指弯处松开瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the loop in one hand and loosens the bottle cap using the crook of her little finger.
shots.narration: 用小指弯处松开瓶盖，拿在手里。

shots.scene: 瓶口在火焰中快速转一圈
shots.prompt_en: The neck of the open glass bottle passes briefly through the flame. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶口在火焰上过一下。

shots.scene: 接种环伸进瓶中旋动
shots.prompt_en: The loop goes into the bottle and swirls gently in the cloudy broth. No people.
shots.narration: 伸入无菌接种环，轻轻旋动取液。

shots.scene: 瓶口再过火，盖回瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The bottle neck passes through the flame again and the cap is screwed back on. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶口再过火，盖回瓶盖。

shots.scene: 环中挂着一层像气泡的液膜
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the loop holding a thin film of liquid like a soap bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 环里有一层液膜，说明取到了。

shots.scene: 小研从标记处开始划第一区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student starts the first zone of streaks near the marked edge of the new dish.
shots.narration: 从标记处开始，划第一区。

shots.scene: 接种环回到瓶中再取的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the loop going back into the broth bottle for more, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 菌只在第一区加一次，不回瓶再取。

shots.scene: 菌落上再挑一次的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the loop going back to the colony for more, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 从菌落转接也一样，不再补菌。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up one finger and smiles.
shots.narration: 多加了菌，就稀释不开了。

shots.scene: 盖盖、灼烧、冷却检验、转盘、相交划线的图标链
shots.prompt_en: A chain of five small icons with arrows: closing a lid, a loop in a flame, a loop touching agar, a rotating dish, and crossing lines. No people.
shots.narration: 之后每区：灼烧、冷却、检验、相交。

shots.scene: 第二区划出四道分开的线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four separate lines of the second zone each crossing the first zone. No people.
shots.narration: 每道单独划，划完就提起。

shots.scene: 最后一区后环直接翻转划竖线和蛇形线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the loop turned over drawing a straight line and a zigzag toward the center of the dish. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一区后，可直接翻环划竖线蛇形线。

shots.scene: 小研灼烧接种环后放回灯座
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flames the loop until it glows, then rests it at the base of the burner.
shots.narration: 划完灼烧接种环，放回灯座。

shots.scene: 两块平板倒扣叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: Two petri dishes, both upside down, stacked one on top of the other. No people.
shots.narration: 两块平板都倒置。

shots.scene: 一根橡皮筋把两块平板捆在一起
shots.prompt_en: A single rubber band is slipped around the two stacked petri dishes. No people.
shots.narration: 用一根橡皮筋捆在一起，不会走散。

shots.scene: 小研把平板放进空白标签的培养盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places the bundled dishes into a plastic box with a blank label for the incubator.
shots.narration: 放进指定的培养盒，送去培养。

shots.scene: 小研转动本生灯进气孔，火焰变成黄色
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the air hole collar of the Bunsen burner closed and the flame turns yellow.
shots.narration: 做完实验，先关进气孔，见到黄焰。

shots.scene: 小研关上燃气阀，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns off the gas tap and the flame goes out.
shots.narration: 再关燃气阀，确认火已熄灭。

shots.scene: 小研再次向台面喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays the bench surface again with the spray bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 台面再喷一遍消毒剂。

shots.scene: 台面上看不见的小液滴被高亮
shots.prompt_en: Tiny droplets on the bench surface are highlighted with small circles. No people.
shots.narration: 以防操作时菌液洒落在台面上。

shots.scene: 小研擦拭台面，纸巾丢进垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench and drops the paper towel into an ordinary trash can.
shots.narration: 擦干台面，纸巾丢进垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap at a lab sink, scrubbing between her fingers.
shots.narration: 离开实验室前，一定要洗手。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦干双手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dries her clean hands with a paper towel beside the lab sink.
shots.narration: 洗干净双手，再离开实验室。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现喷壶和本生灯图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a spray bottle and a Bunsen burner.
shots.narration: 先消毒台面，点灯，黄焰待用。

shots.scene: 标记平板和四区划线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a labeled petri dish base and a four-zone streak diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 皿底边缘做标记，四区逐区稀释。

shots.scene: 火焰中的接种环和盖上的皿盖图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a loop glowing in a flame and a lid closing on a dish. No people.
shots.narration: 每区灼烧冷却，皿盖尽快盖回。

shots.scene: 倒置的两块平板和橡皮筋
shots.prompt_en: Two upside-down petri dishes bundled with a rubber band. No people.
shots.narration: 只在第一区接种，倒置培养。

shots.scene: 关灯、消毒、洗手三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a burner being turned off, a spray bottle, and washing hands. No people.
shots.narration: 关火、消毒台面，洗手再离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 动手去多划几块平板吧，下次见！
